charlespips wrote: Hey Andrea! How's life there? It seems you are having a great time:)

Just stopping by here to check and found your post. That's a nice impatience there But I have a question for you, if you are patience enough, would your best entry point be the one I marked with red arrow?:)

Cheers

Hi Charles, thanks for stopping by. Sure, that was the one. After entering my HTF Zone, Price rejected, engulfed the last FTR upwards, retraced to a "micro QM level". Enters could have been at that QM level OR at close of your marked bar, being that a BEOB of the retracement. THIS is what I mean with the need to learn to read PA in the important zones.

I hope you catched it nicely.

One of my main problems (part of Greed) is the fear to "lose the train" and therefore jump on it often too early... But I want to force myself in future (at least for a while

) to wait for the train to stop or

not jumping on at all... And see what happens!

Thank you.

(PS: about the problem of posting your pics...look at this: readthemarket.com/index.php/forum/welcom...ts-attachments#17353 I had the same problem a few times, I think you wanted now to load from a web storage? or perhaps too big?..Ben Hur not happy at all...Ben Hur not loading

سلام Charles، ممنون که سر زدی. بله، همان بود. بعد از ورود به ناحیهٔ HTF، قیمت رد شد، آخرین FTR را به سمت بالا اینگالف کرد و به یک «سطح QM خرد» برگشت زد. ورود می‌توانست روی همان سطح QM باشد یا در کلوز کندلی که علامت زده‌ای، چون آن یک BEOB از برگشت بود. همین است منظوری از نیاز به یاد گرفتن خواندن PA در نواحی مهم.

امیدوارم خوب متوجه شده باشی.

یکی از مشکلات اصلی من (بخشی از طمع) ترس از «جا ماندن از قطار» است و همین باعث می‌شود اغلب خیلی زود سوارش شوم… اما می‌خواهم در آینده خودم را مجبور کنم (دست‌کم برای مدتی

اصلاً سوار نشوم… و ببینم چه می‌شود!

ممنون.

two fast scalps

and then the beauty of watching Price, doing what it is expected to do, reading why it didn't when it didn't, and forecasting what I can expect next. Lovely training.
